name: Python
author: MicroPython (Damien P. George and contributors)
description: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) in the Terminal: interactive prompt, scripts and modules. Type python for the prompt, python script.py to run a file from /sdcard/home.

descriptions.en: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) in the Terminal: interactive prompt, scripts and modules. Type python for the prompt, python script.py to run a file from /sdcard/home.
descriptions.it: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) nel Terminale: prompt interattivo, script e moduli. Scrivi python per il prompt, python script.py per eseguire un file da /sdcard/home.

usage: python FILE.py [ARGS] runs a script (paths from /sdcard/home: cd ~ first or use ~/file.py); python -c 'CODE' runs one line; python alone opens the prompt (Terminal only). MicroPython 1.26: core Python 3 + os, json, re, math, random, time; no pip, no threads, no sockets.

does.en: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) for scripts and quick calculations: python -c 'print(2**64)' or write ~/x.py then python ~/x.py. No pip, threads or sockets.
does.it: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) per script e calcoli veloci: python -c 'print(2**64)' oppure scrivi ~/x.py e poi python ~/x.py. Niente pip, thread o socket.
